highlights: Hi-Fi Sound Quality: This USB C to Aux Cable transfers sound directly from a Type-C phone/tablet/laptop to the 3.5mm audio output device. The USB C to Aux Cord supports up to 24-bit/96kHz with an advanced DAC chip, has excellent and stable decoding performance, and provides high-fidelity stereo audio output and the cleanest sound experience

Support Mic and In-Line Control: UGREENUSB C to 3.5mm Audio Adapter not only supports listening to music but also supports using the microphone function of headsets. This Aux Cord for iPhone 15 is ideal for game playing and video calls. Note: The maximum audio output sample rate depends on the input and output device

Compact and Durable Design: The USB C to Aux Cord is made of flexible and durable material. The USB C to Aux Cable has an aluminum alloy shell and metal plug to resist oxidation and corrosion, the tail anti-bending design has been tested for more than 15,000 bending tests and is strong enough to withstand twisting, pulling, and tangling. Multi-shielding provides stable audio transmission

Out in the Box: The USB C Headphone Adapter for Car plug and play easily, connects your Type C devices to your car stereo, speakers, headphones, or any device with a 3.5mm auxiliary output port. Note: Does Not support connecting a phone with a 3.5mm port to a headset with a USB C port

Wide Compatibility: This 3.5mm to USB C is compatible with iPhone 17 Pro Max/17 Pro/Air/17/16 Pro Max/16 Pro/16 Plus/16/15 Pro Max/15 Pro/15 Plus/15, Samsung Galaxy S25/S24/S24 Ultra/S24 Plus/S23 Ultra/S23/S23 Ultra/S23+/S22/S22 Ultra/S22+/Note20/Note20 Ultra/S20 Ultra/S20, Google Pixel 10 Pro/10 Pro XL/10/10 Pro Fold/9/9 Pro/9XL/8/8 Pro/7/7 Pro, iPad mini/iPad Pro/iPad Air, iMac, Macbook Pro/Air, most of the Type C phones, PS5
